name: ABEJA,Inc.
summary: ABEJA, Inc. is in the digital platform business. Its ABEJA platform is a software suite covering design, development, construction, operation and improvement to suit client needs, and it also acts as a digital version of an electronics manufacturing service. It offers ongoing client support and ABEJA LLM services such as DX strategy, business process reform and education. Incorporated in 2012, it has its base in Minato, Japan.
